note: stock: restart_ddns; with Let's Encrypt and DDNS on restart_ddns_le;prepare_cert; a certificate change with HTTPS on added prepare_cert;restart_webdav (+restart_ddns_le when leaving Let's Encrypt); FTP over TLS added prepare_cert;restart_ftpd.
